idea-plugin.name: Workspace Source Redirector
idea-plugin.description:
Jumps to workspace sources instead of decompiled jars. Redirects Java go-to-declaration (Ctrl+Click / Ctrl+B) and go-to-implementation (Ctrl+Alt+B / Ctrl+Alt+Click) to the matching project sources inside the same workspace.
When several Java projects are open in one IDE window and project A depends on project B, Ctrl+Click on a class from B usually lands in the decompiled jar in the local repository. This plugin resolves the class by its fully qualified name against the workspace sources instead, regardless of whether the dependency version matches the source version.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.0

  • Go to Implementation now overrides the GotoImplementation action instead of contributing to definitionsScopedSearch, so global inheritance searches are left untouched.
  • Implementations are matched by FQCN plus erased method signature, so a call site compiled against an older jar still navigates to the newer workspace implementation.
  • Fallback chain: source copies of the interface, then XxxServiceImpl, then a word-in-text scan over workspace sources that does not rely on the inheritance index.
  • Search scope is the current project itself, which already covers all of its imported modules; projects opened next to it are never searched.
  • Go to Declaration also looks for sources in the other workspace projects, not only in the current one; a folder opened without any source root falls back to the file name index so that source lookup still works.

1.1.0

  • Rebuilt with the IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin; bytecode now targets Java 8.
  • Compatible with IntelliJ IDEA 2023.1 (build 231) and later, with no upper version bound.
  • Core behavior unchanged: go-to-declaration and go-to-implementation redirect to workspace sources.

action.description: Go to implementation(s) in workspace sources
